hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southern Africa, between Mozambique and South Africa || mostly mountains and hills; some moderately sloping plains || landlocked; almost completely surrounded by South Africa || Resources: asbestos, coal, clay, cassiterite, hydropower, forests, small gold and diamond deposits, quarry stone, and talc || Exports: scented mixtures, raw sugar, industrial acids/oils/alcohols, garments, wood (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly mountains and hills; some moderately sloping plains || Southern Africa, between Mozambique and South Africa

climate.excerpt: varies from tropical to near temperate || drought

economy.excerpt: landlocked southern African economy; South African trade dependent and currency pegging; CMA and SACU member state; COVID-19 economic slowdown; growing utilities inflation; persistent poverty and unemployment; HIV/AIDS labor force disruptions || Exports: scented mixtures, raw sugar, industrial acids/oils/alcohols, garments, wood (2023) || Industries: soft drink concentrates, coal, forestry, sugar processing, textiles, and apparel

peopleAndCulture.from: People and Society > Languages, Religions, Ethnic groups, Urbanization
peopleAndCulture.excerpt: English (official, used for government business), siSwati (official) || Christian 90% (Zionist - a blend of Christianity and traditional African religions - 40%, Roman Catholic 20%, other Christian 30% - includes Anglican, Methodist, Church of Jesus Christ, Jehovah's Witness), Muslim 2%, other 8% (includes Baha'i, Buddhist, Hindu, indigenous, Jewish) (2015 est.) || predominantly Swazi; smaller populations of other African ethnic groups, including the Zulu, as well as people of European ancestry
